description: Aggregate a single germplasm's observations across every study it appears in, returning per-variable summary statistics (n, mean, median, sd, min, max), the contributing studies, and seasons. Study-anchored: discovers the germplasm's studies first (with a dialect-honor cross-check, capped at 200 studies), then pulls observations per study — avoids the unanchored germplasm-only pull that stalls on SGN/Breedbase. Pass an explicit studyDbIds set to skip discovery and its 200-study cap — e.g. process a chunk of the full study list retrieved via brapi_find_studies with extraFilters.germplasmDbIds. For the underlying observation matrix, use brapi_build_phenotype_matrix.

alias.description: Connection alias. Omit to use alias `default`. An alias registered via brapi_connect works, and so does one the server has a URL configured for (a built-in alias, an operator-configured alias, or `default` on a deployment with a default server), which connects on first use. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

germplasmDbId.description: The germplasmDbId to summarize performance for.

studyDbIds.description: Optional explicit set of studyDbIds to aggregate over. When supplied, skips automatic study discovery and its 200-study cap entirely — use it to process a specific slice of studies, e.g. the full germplasm-scoped study set retrieved via brapi_find_studies with extraFilters.germplasmDbIds. Omit to let the tool discover the germplasm’s studies automatically.

variables.description: Optional subset of observationVariableDbIds to aggregate. Omit to include every variable observed for the germplasm.

name: brapi_germplasm_performance

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection is registered under the requested alias, and the server has no base URL configured for it to connect on first use. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: Connecting the alias on first use, the SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Connecting the alias on first use, the token endpoint answered without returning an access token. `capability_discovery_unavailable`: Neither /serverinfo nor /calls listed any call, and at least one of them timed out, was unreachable, or answered 429 or a 5xx other than 501, so nothing was cached. `upstream_unauthorized`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 401: it requires credentials, or rejected the ones sent. `upstream_forbidden`: The BrAPI server answered HTTP 403: the credentials sent, or their absence, lack access. `alias_base_url_invalid`: The base URL configured on the server for this alias is not an absolute http(s) URL, or carries credentials. `private_address_blocked`: The base URL configured for this alias, or its token URL, is on a private or reserved address this server may not reach. `germplasm_not_found`: Upstream returned no germplasm record for the requested germplasmDbId. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

germplasmName.description: Display name of the germplasm, when the server provides one.

items.description: Aggregated statistics for one observation variable across the studies the germplasm appears in.

max.description: Maximum value — numeric max when numeric, else lexical max.

mean.description: Arithmetic mean of numeric values (omitted for non-numeric traits).

median.description: Median of numeric values (omitted for non-numeric traits).

min.description: Minimum value — numeric min when numeric, else lexical min.

n.description: Number of observations of this variable for the germplasm.

sd.description: Sample standard deviation (n−1) of numeric values; omitted when n < 2 or non-numeric.

seasons.description: Distinct season labels across the observations (empty when the server carries no season).

studyCount.description: Number of distinct studies contributing observations of this variable.

studyDbIds.description: Distinct studyDbIds contributing observations of this variable.

studyCount.description: Number of distinct studies that contributed any observation.

warnings.description: Advisory messages (study-discovery limits, dropped filters, fallback paths, per-study failures, partial study scans).

title: Brapi Germplasm Performance
